Sharing my story here!
I was suffering from severe breakup 
He was very abusive and threaten me if I ever leave him 
I got strength to leave him ...
I was not hurt but actually free like I lost myself and found again 
I was so happy and thought I will be never in relationship again 
Then
My friend introduced me to her friend 
I didn't like the way he talk , he was a flirt
But soon i came to know he is suffering from breakup , it was his first relationship and she cheated badly 
That thing changed everything in me about him 
I was a very shy girl but our first call lasts for 2 hrs I was hell surprised because I didn't even realised the time 
But he was my good friend let's say his name is D
I had a crush on my senior But he was also suffering from breakup he wants to focus on his career 
I confessed to him but he rejected me I felt lonely I told everything to D he used to send me videos songs to cope up with that 
But..
Then there was guy in my college he is like a bully he was interested in me he threatened my friends to stay away from me ... He brought some goons to beat my friends 
Everyone blocked me I was so threatened 
I called D to tell him to stay away from me 
I didn't want him to be hurt 
I cried so badly and expressed he is my best friend I can't imagine him hurting because of me 
He said I am here to be with you don't worry I will be near with you and just come to me I am always there for you 
I felt like he is not a new person I felt like I knew him from decades he never felt a new person 
I really feel very safe with him and so protective 
And with him I feel like he is my part only 
As we don't need words to talk he understands me just by looking into my eyes 
I never knew behind that flirt there is such a gentleman 

But that time he was just my friend but a special one 
He sorted that matter with the bully 
But my crush , the senior was getting on my nerves but at the same time I started feeling belongingness with D 
One day, D said don't focus on who doesn't love you back ..focus on the ones who are here to fight for the whole world for you 
I felt very strange feeling inside me ..

The next day he said I am not attached with anyone but you are really special to me I don't mind attaching with you 

Then we started talking daily 
We used to video call and doesn't speak any word for hours just looking into each other's eyes in silence like for hours 
One day he said I used to feel someone has clenched my heart but looking into your eyes it feels like my heart is being free from that 
It feels so good ,it feels like therapy 
That only thing made me block my crush I felt like that senior is not my crush anymore 
Then on my birthday he brought me cake and surprised me 
Then the next day he said I kinda love you 
Maybe you will be my forever or my last and the worst breakup 
I replied I don't know I love you or not I just know I want to be with you , you are so special 
Then next day he confessed 21 january I love you
I replied I love you more but what if you also like him (my ex) what if you also abuse or like that 
That day he promised me that gave a free will if ever in life forget about abuse ,if I ever raise my voice in front of you , you are allowed to slap me in front of everyone no matter who is standing 
But I can't tolerate disloyalty 
I said I am here to stay 

It's been 2 years now he never yelled he never raised his voice infact he made me shy to bold girl 
I am bossy around him he is like yes mam yes mam 
He made everyday like festival 
And we both are working towards our career now 
He introduced me to his parents 
By god grace we will marry in next 3 yrs 

He is the best thing that has ever happened to me 
He made my fear tears turn into happy tears 
He has all the qualities of the man I have ever dreamed of 
It is a blessing to be loved by a calm and a man with patience

The Girl Who Loved the Rain

Aarav had never believed in love at first sight.

He believed in timing, conversations, and the slow way strangers become home.

One rainy afternoon, while hiding inside a small library from the storm, he noticed a girl sitting by the window. She wasn't reading the book in her hands. She was watching the raindrops race down the glass, smiling as if the rain were telling her a secret.

Her name was Mira.

The first thing they ever said to each other was about a missing bookmark.

The second was about coffee.

The third lasted four hours.

Days became weeks, and somehow they kept meeting—at the library, at the café across the street, at the park where the old banyan tree stood. They learned each other's little habits.

Mira always laughed before telling a joke.

Aarav always remembered everyone's favorite song.

She loved sunsets.

He loved sunrises.

So they agreed to watch both together.

When Mira was afraid of failing her exams, Aarav stayed awake all night helping her study.

When Aarav lost confidence in himself, Mira reminded him of every dream he had almost forgotten.

Neither tried to change the other.

Instead, they helped each other become the best versions of themselves.

Years passed.

Life became busier. There were misunderstandings, long-distance days, missed calls, and silent nights. More than once, they wondered if love was enough.

But every time one stepped back, the other stepped forward.

Not because their relationship was perfect.

Because they chose each other, again and again.

One evening, they returned to the same library where they had first met.

The rain had started just like it had years ago.

Aarav smiled and held out an old bookmark.

"I think this belongs to you."

Mira laughed.

"I've been looking for it for years."

He knelt down, holding a small velvet box.

"I don't promise a life without storms," he said softly. "I promise I'll stand beside you in every one of them."

With tears in her eyes, she whispered, "Yes."

They married the following spring.

Their home was never the biggest or the fanciest, but it was always full of music, books, plants, laughter, and the smell of fresh tea after the rain.

When they grew old, their hair turned silver, and their hands became wrinkled.

Every monsoon, they still sat by the same window.

Watching raindrops race down the glass.

Just like the day they met.

One afternoon, their granddaughter asked,

"What is the secret to true love?"

Mira smiled at Aarav.

He smiled back.

And together they answered,

"Love isn't finding the perfect person.

It's choosing the same imperfect person every single day—and making them feel loved, no matter what."

Outside, the rain continued to fall.

Inside, two hearts that had once been strangers still felt like home.

The End.
